With over 100 years of combined experience, our team specializes in custom-built products and offers expertise in a wide range of materials. about:
Martin's Steel LLC has operated from Mifflinburg, Pennsylvania since 1976. The family-owned company was founded that year and has served the surrounding region with metal fabrication and manufacturing services.

The shop provides custom fabrication, welding, laser cutting, and manufacturing of truck bodies and trailers. It also offers welding and torching gas refills through cylinder exchanges. The company works with stainless steel, aluminum, and steel, using what it describes as state-of-the-art equipment for welding and laser cutting. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Martin's Steel serves industrial and commercial customers, as well as personal and recreational users for trailers and truck bodies. Its fabrication services are tailored to a range of industrial and commercial needs, while its custom truck bodies and trailers are built for both commercial and personal use.

The company emphasizes a 100% satisfaction guarantee, free estimates typically delivered within three to four days, and in-store pickup and delivery. It cites over 100 years of combined team experience and its family-owned heritage as foundations of its approach.
